content: Yakub Mišorot zar
Tarfore Israile hibar hár kissu loi baisa diyore Beer-Šebat aišše, edde hibaye hibar baf Isakor Allar mutallek kurbani okkol diye.
Allaye raitta Israilore deha diyore hodde, "Yakub, Yakub!" hibaye hodde, So, oto ãi.
Toi hibaye hodde, "Ãi Allah, tor bafor Allah; Lamat Mišorot zaite tui no ḍorais, kiyollahoile heṛe ãi tore ek ḍõr zati goriyum.
Ãi tor fũwati lamat Mišorot zaiyum, edde hentu ãi tore abar uwafes firai o loi ainnum, ar tor sukor fata Yusufor nizor hate bandi dibo."

Toi Yakube Beer-Šebattu baisa diye. Israilor futainde hitarar baf Yakubore, edde hitara nizor nizor futziyain okkolore, edde bouwain okkolore, oi gũragari okkol, zin Feruwane hibare boiloizaibolla defeṛail, hinot gori loi giye.
Ar hitara hitarar zanuwar okkol edde Kenanot hamailde hár šombotti okkol fũwati loi, Yakub edde hibar fura bongšo ṭiya hibar fũwati, Mišorot aigiyegoi.
Yakube hibar futain, futaindor fuwain, ziyain, ziyaindor ziyain, hibar gũṛa bongšo ṭiyare hibar fũwati Mišorot loi anniye.
In okkol oilde Israilor futain okkol nam okkol (Yakub edde hibar bongšo okkol) zara Mišorot aišše:
Yakubor foila zormo Ruben.
Rubenor futain okkol: Hanok, Pallu, Hešron edde Karmi.
Simeonor futain okkol: Jemuwel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Sohar edde Šaul he Kenaniyo mayafuwar fut.
Levir futain okkol: Geršon, Kekat edde Merari.
Ehudar futain okkol: Er, Onan, Šela, Feroš edde Šerah. (Er edde Onan Kenan dešot entehal goijje.) Ferošor futain okkol: Hešron edde Hamul.
Issakaror futain okkol: Tola, Puvah, Job ar Šimron.
Sebulunor futain okkol: Serod, Elun ar Jahalel.
Itara oilde Lear futain okkol, zarare hibaye Paddan-Aramot Yakubolla biyail, fũwati hibar zi Dina šoho. Hitara mayafuwain edde morod fuwain beggune muṭ triš tinzon.
Gador futain okkol: Sifiyon, Haggi, Šuni, Esbon, Eri, Arodi edde Areli.
Ašeror futain okkol: Jimna, Jišba, Jišbi, Beriyah, edde hitarar boin Serah. Beriyar futain okkol: Heber edde Malhiyel.
Itara he Zilpar fuwain zare Labone nizor ziyore bandi hisabe dil, hibaye Yakubolla itarare biyaiye. Itara beggune šullo zon.
Yakubor bou Rahelar futain okkol: Yusuf edde Benyamin.
Ar Mišorot, Manessare edde Efraimore On šohoror imam Putiferar zi Asenate Yusufolla biyaiye.
Benjaminor futain okkol: Bela, Beker, Ašbel, Gera, Naman, Ehi, Ruš, Muffim, Huffim edde Ard.
Itara aššilde Rahelar futain okkol, zarare Yakubolla biyaiye. Hitara muṭ soiddo zon.
Danor fut: Hušim.
Naftalir futain okkol: Zahšiyel, Guni, Jezer edde Šillem.
Itara aššilde Bilhar futain, zare Labone nizor ziyore bandi hisabe dil. Hibaye Yakubolla itarare biyaiye. Hitara muṭ hãt zon.
Hitara zarare loi Yakube Mišorot aiyat aššil, zara hibar nizor bongšottu, Yakubor futaindor bouwain okkol sara, hitara muṭ haiṭ so zon.
Mišorot Yusufottu ze dui fut zormo oiye, edde Yakubor gušṭi zara Mišorot aišše hitara beggune muṭ hoittor zon.
Bade Yakube hibar age Ehudare Yusufor hãse defeṛaiye, zene hibaye hitare Gušenot zaibar fõt dehai de, toi hitara Gušen elehat aišše.
Toi Yusufe hibar nizor gũra garire hãzaiyore Gušenot hibar baf Israil loi deha goitto giye. Toi bafore zehon deikke, golat dori bout hotun hainde.
Hetunot Israile Yusufore hodde, "Ãi ehon moribolla tiyar! Tui zinda asos, ãi tor siyara dekilam."

Toi Yusufe hibar báiyain okkol edde hibar bafor góror manuš okkolore hodde, "Ãi Feruwanor hãse zai ei hóborgan hoigoi, hibare hoiyum, 'Ãr báiyain edde bafor góror manuš okkol zara Kenanot takito, hitara ãr hãse aišše.
Hitara soolsoroya okkol; hitara goru sool faloya okkol. Hitara hitarar goru, sool, edde hitarar nizor hár kissu fũwati loi aišše.'
Ar Feruwane tũwarare zẽtte ḍakibo edde fusar goribo, 'Tũwarar feša ki?'

Tũwara hoiba, 'Õnor ei gulam okkol edde hitarar baf dada okkole šoṛo halottu loti ehon foijjonto goru sool fali aiyer.' toi zene tũwara Gušenot takifariba, kiyollahoile soolsoroya okkol mani Mišoriyo okkolor hingšar ziniš."
